title: Committed work waiting to land
current: An item whose active implementation lane has a recorded commit and whose only unmet edges are integration edges waits instead of being ready, because landing is all that is left. One shared rule in the Frontier computation gives it one sentence naming each blocker and condition, such as Waiting on PREFIX-1, PREFIX-2 to merge. frontier.list marks its blocked rows holds_pickup with that sentence, so the web Frontier puts it in Waiting with the sentence on its tile and yoke frontier list prints it; the steering report lists unclaimed such items under waiting to land instead of available work. Any unmet activation edge keeps its own reason. Blocker pairs are sorted by public prefix, numeric item sequence, then satisfaction before grouping, so the sentence stays identical regardless of database row order.
